properties.notes: This site is identified as an Area of Change (AOC7) within the Core Strategy. The site is privately owned by 2 separate owners. The owners have confirmed their intention to redevelop the site with the possibility of a comprehensive development. An application to demolish the redundant gasholder onsite has recently been approved (AWDM/1949/16-08/02/2017). It is expected that the site could deliver approximately 85 residential units..
